[Sir](/person/981)
I am obliged to you for forwarding the cheque for[£25](/topic/160) for the first edition of the [Two Guardians](/book/13).
I am at present too much engaged to think of publishing anything in the [Churchman’s Companion](/periodical/62),[^1] though I am obliged to you for the proposal.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY had contributed The Two Guardians (1850-2) to The Churchman\'s Companion, published by Masters.
